data_source: Official DES Y3A2 released 2pt MagLim and redMaGiC FITS files; read ONLY NZ_LENS and no observed two-point data or covariance.
native_z_span: actual LW01/LW02 8 native z nodes, read from archived LW02 parent

results.do_report: For each calibrated lens n(z) kernel compute fraction of its normalized n(z) mass inside native z interval, and inside k,z intersection for each preregistered ell; report source file hash and read-only schema.
results.no_go: Even >=99% true n(z) kernel mass does NOT authorize gamma_t(theta) or pseudoCl observable: broad angular windows, leakage, source n(z), nonlinear bias, gauge, physical eta, cross spectrum must separately pass. Missing 1% contribution cannot be set to zero without physical bound.
results.prohibit: no observed two-point values, no likelihood fit, no posthoc choice based on observed residuals, no CLASS re-execution

recorded_preexecution_source_identifier_.reason: Official DES NCSA directory lists redmagic file with `_wnz_redmagic_covupdate.fits`, not third-party Cobaya mirror's `_wnz_covupdate.v2.fits`. Corrected before any DES NZ_LENS values were accessed.
